coordinate_contract.boundaries: RA=360 wraps to 0; Dec=+90 is outside the half-open grid; radial interval is closed at both frozen limits
coordinate_contract.mask_index: RA is normalized to [0,360); Dec must lie in [-90,90); i=floor(RA*resolution), j=floor((Dec+90)*resolution)
coordinate_contract.transform: x=r*cos(dec)*cos(ra); y=r*cos(dec)*sin(ra); z=r*sin(dec), angles in radians
coordinate_contract.validation_after_decode: Before scoring, table1 (x,y,z,s,RAdeg,DEdeg) must satisfy the frozen transform within 1e-9 relative and 1e-8 h^-1 Mpc absolute tolerance.

distance_contract.cf4_type: DMzp and Dist are luminosity distances
distance_contract.conversion: Invert D_L=(1+z)D_C in frozen flat Planck2018 cosmology, then r_h_inverse_Mpc=(H0/100)D_C. Never use cz/H0 as target distance.
distance_contract.vast_type: sphere coordinates are Planck2018 comoving h^-1 Mpc

scope.allowed: Target-blind correlation-only CF4 x VAST sphere-path screen after a separately frozen executor
scope.coverage: Primary rows must have the full observer-to-target ray inside the angular mask and frozen radial interval; partial rays are retained only as explicit L_unobserved counterexamples and are not primary scores.

version_boundary.claim: The acquired CDS sphere tables and the Zenodo mask are sufficient for a correlation-only screen. Byte identity between CDS sphere rows and Zenodo v1.3.1 sphere files is not claimed; mechanism inference is forbidden.
version_boundary.official_release_note: v1.3.1 corrected NSAID values in V2 galzones files
